product_overview: AMIK CHAT is a comprehensive real-time messaging and communication web application focused on bilingual support (English/Urdu). Built with modern technologies including Next.js, React, Firebase, and Tailwind CSS, it offers seamless text/chat messaging, multimedia sharing, voice and video calls via WebRTC, contact management, AI-powered translation, and integration with mini-programs to provide a rich user experience across desktop and mobile platforms.
core_goals: Enable secure and real-time text and multimedia messaging with rich media support.
Provide seamless peer-to-peer voice and video calling using WebRTC technology.
Facilitate efficient contact management with AI-powered suggestions, QR code scanning, and a request-based system.
Deliver bilingual messaging experience with AI-powered automatic English-Urdu translations.
Integrate mini-programs such as QR code scanner and AI agents for enhanced user engagement.
Ensure scalable, performant, and secure communication leveraging Firebase services and optimized frontend architecture.
Offer user profile customization, privacy controls, and multi-device responsive design.
key_features: User Authentication and Profile Management with email/password login, avatar upload, and profile editing.
Real-time Chat Messaging supporting text, images, files, voice messages, locations, and contact sharing.
Voice and Video Calls with peer-to-peer connectivity, call signaling, and call control features.
Contacts Management with add/search by AMIK ID, QR code scan, requests management, and AI-driven contact suggestions.
Message Translation feature supporting automatic English-Urdu AI-powered translations with fallback dictionary.
File Sharing and Management supporting multiple file formats, base64 encoding, upload progress, and previews.
QR Code Scanner for adding contacts and generating styled QR codes.
Mini-Programs ecosystem allowing integration and discovery of external mini-applications.
Security and Privacy controls including message deletion options, session management, and data isolation.
Cross-platform support with responsive UI targeting desktop and mobile browsers.
user_flow_summary: Registration Flow: Users sign up with email/password, provide profile info, then get redirected to the main app.
Login Flow: Users authenticate via email/password, establish a session, and enter the chat interface.
Chat Flow: Users select contacts or open chats, load messages in real-time, send multimedia or text messages, and receive instant updates.
Contact Request Flow: Users search or scan QR codes to send requests, with notifications and mutual contact synchronization upon acceptance.
Call Flow: Users initiate voice/video calls from chat, handle offer/answer signaling through Firebase, and manage calls with UI controls.
File Sharing Flow: Users upload files with preview, confirm sending, and have shared files displayed and downloadable in chat.
validation_criteria: Authentication and registration processes function correctly with secure session handling.
Real-time messaging reliably updates within 1 second latency.
Voice and video calls establish connections within 3 seconds and maintain quality with functional call controls.
Contact requests are sent, received, accepted, and reflected in mutual contact lists properly.
AI-powered English-Urdu message translation returns accurate translations with fallback handled gracefully.
Files upload successfully with accurate previews and downloads, and drag-and-drop works as intended.
QR code scanning accurately reads codes to add contacts and generates valid QR codes.
Mini-programs launch and operate correctly within the app environment.
User profile changes persist and privacy controls operate securely.
Cross-browser and device responsive UI behaves consistently without major layout or functionality issues.
